sun.java2d.pipe.hw

接口 AccelGraphicsConfig

  • 所有超级接口:
    BufferedContextProvider
    所有已知实现类:
    D3DGraphicsConfig

    public interface AccelGraphicsConfig
extends BufferedContextProvider
    Implementors of this interface provida a way to create a VolatileImage whose destination surface is an AccelSurface of specified type.
    另请参阅:
    AccelSurface

    • 方法详细资料

      • createCompatibleVolatileImage

        VolatileImage createCompatibleVolatileImage(int width,
                                            int height,
                                            int transparency,
                                            int type)
        Returns a VolatileImage with specified width, height, transparency and guaranteed accelerated surface type. If such image can not be created (out of vram error, specific surface type is not supported) null is returned. Note: if AccelSurface.TEXTURE type is requested, rendering to the image will be denied by throwing UnsupportedOperationException from VolatileImage.getGraphics() and VolatileImage.createGraphics()
        参数:
        width - the width of the returned VolatileImage
        height - the height of the returned VolatileImage
        transparency - the specified transparency mode
        type - requested accelerated surface type as specified by constants in AccelSurface interface
        返回:
        a VolatileImage backed up by requested accelerated surface type or null
        抛出:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the transparency is not a valid value
        另请参阅:
        AccelSurface.TEXTURE, AccelSurface.RT_PLAIN, AccelSurface.RT_TEXTURE

      • addDeviceEventListener

        void addDeviceEventListener(AccelDeviceEventListener l)
        Adds an AccelDeviceEventListener to listen to accelerated device's (which is associated with this AccelGraphicsConfig) events. Note: a hard link to the listener may be kept so it must be explicitly removed via #removeDeviceEventListener().
        参数:
        l - the listener
        另请参阅:
        AccelDeviceEventListener

      • removeDeviceEventListener

        参数:
        l - the listener
        另请参阅:
        AccelDeviceEventListener
